calculation.description: During elevated VIX regimes, rank assets by 20-day cumulative return residual to rolling 60-day SPX beta; otherwise use 20-day trend. VIX stress state is above its trailing 252-day 65th percentile. All inputs are lagged one session.

validation.regime_notes: 20-day admission metrics pass the benchmark gates, but predictive strength weakened after 2026 and was negative in 2029+ and 2030. Treat as regime-sensitive and revalidate promptly.
